title: 书封、书脊、装帧封面烫金膜怎么选？

seo.title: 书封、书脊、装帧封面烫金膜怎么选？

content:
## 内容定位

用于 Reddit r/bookbinding、Briar Press、装帧/书封/书脊/笔记本封面烫金场景。

## Reddit 英文短评版

For book covers, the cover material matters a lot.

Paper, cloth, buckram, PU leather and genuine leather all need different stamping behavior. If the foil looks patchy, it may be texture, uneven pressure or the wrong foil grade.

I would test small text, spine lines and a small solid area before choosing the foil.

## PrintPlanet 技术长评版

Book cover foil stamping should be evaluated according to cover material and artwork detail.

Common cover materials such as paper, cloth, buckram, PU leather and genuine leather behave differently under heat and pressure. Cloth and textured covers often require better coverage and pressure control. Leather covers require careful temperature control to avoid pressure marks or surface damage.

A practical test form should include:

1. Small title text

1. Spine line

1. Logo

1. Solid block

1. Reverse text

If small text breaks, a fine-detail foil may be needed. If solid areas are patchy, a foil with better coverage or a smoother cover material may be required.

## 知乎中文科普版

书封、书脊、装帧封面烫金，首先要看封面材料。

常见材料有纸面、布面、buckram、PU皮、真皮和特种纸。材料不同，烫金难点也不同。

纸面封面重点看边缘清晰度。  

布面和纹理封面重点看覆盖完整度。  

皮革封面重点看温度、压痕、耐摩擦和耐弯折。  

特种纸重点看纸面粗糙度和是否掉粉。

测试时不要只看书名大字，最好同时测试书脊细线、小字、logo和小面积实地图案。

## 阿里国际站成交版

For book cover and spine foil stamping, please confirm your cover material: paper, cloth, buckram, PU leather or genuine leather.

We can recommend different foil grades for fine text, logo stamping or solid-area stamping.

Please send your cover material sample and artwork. We can provide suitable foil samples and color options for testing.

## 自然 CTA

If helpful, we can provide a book cover foil test checklist and small sample rolls for your cover material.
